description: For each option, identify who would bear the cost if it goes wrong and when that cost would land, looking past the person making the request.
when_to_apply: choosing between mitigating now and investigating longer
a risky launch date is proposed
someone asks for an exception to a rule that protects others
steps: Name everyone who absorbs the downside of each option, including people not in the conversation.
Note when the cost lands - now, overnight, over a weekend.
Weigh costs to people who did not accept the risk more heavily than costs to the person asking.
quality_indicators: the cost to absent parties was stated explicitly
the timing of the cost was part of the decision
failure_modes: treating an investigation as free when customers are paying for it
example: Asked to skip a maintenance notice for one partner, the incident commander first asks which other customers would carry the cost if the upgrade went badly.
